review_candidates.title: EHS Manager
review_candidates.description: A Snapshot of Your Day As the EHS Manager for Latin America, you will play a pivotal role in strengthening Siemens Gamesa’s Zero Harm culture across Service Operations throughout the region, including Mexico, Brazil, Chile, Argentina, Uruguay, Peru, and other Latin American countries. Working closely with the Americas EHS leadership team and operational leaders, you will provide strategic direction, operational support, and leadership to EHS professionals while driving continuous improvement, regulatory compliance, and risk management. Your mission will be to ensure that every employee and contractor returns home safely every day while enabling operational excellence across wind service activities and major projects. How You’ll Make An Impact Lead the execution of Siemens Gamesa’s EHS strategy across Latin America, driving a strong Zero Harm culture and embedding safety excellence into all service operations. Partner with operational leaders to proactively identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with wind turbine maintenance, field service activities, and major projects. Develop and coach a high-performing team of EHS professionals, fostering collaboration, accountability, and consistent implementation of company standards across the region. Drive continuous improvement through the analysis of safety performance data, incident trends, audits, and leading indicators, translating insights into measurable actions. Ensure compliance with local regulations, Siemens Gamesa policies, and customer requirements while strengthening governance, critical risk controls, and operational discipline. Enhance contractor safety performance by partnering with Supply Chain and Operations teams to improve contractor qualification, onboarding, performance monitoring, and corrective action processes. What You Bring Bachelor's or Master's degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, Occupational Health & Safety, or a related technical discipline. Extensive EHS leadership experience within wind energy, field service operations, construction, manufacturing, utilities, power generation, or similar industrial environments, including proven success managing EHS teams, developing regional safety programs, and driving operational excellence through safety leadership. Strong leadership capabilities with experience leading geographically dispersed teams, influencing senior stakeholders, and driving cultural and organizational change across complex organizations. Demonstrated expertise in serious incident investigations, corrective action management, organizational learning, contractor management systems, and risk management methodologies. Fluent English is required, along with proficiency in either Spanish or Portuguese. Availability to travel across Latin America as business needs require (approximately 25-30%). About Siemens Gamesa Siemens Gamesa is a global leader in renewable energy and part of Siemens Energy. We are dedicated to driving the energy transition and creating sustainable solutions for future generations. Our people work every day to make reliable, affordable, and clean energy a reality, helping societies reduce carbon emissions while ensuring energy security around the world. Our Commitment to Diversity Fortunately for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate energy. We foster inclusion, and our collective creative power is fueled by more than 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates individuality, regardless of ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society as a whole and do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits Career growth and development opportunities Encouraging work culture and a healthy work- life balance Flexible benefits and savings programs Contribute to our social responsibility initiatives Diversity and inclusivity focused Parental leave https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

review_candidates.title: Director of Facilitation and Instruction, Campus Climate Initiative
review_candidates.description: Hillel International Role Overview The Director of Instruction leads learning opportunities for various higher education audiences, including university administrators, faculty, and staff, as well as professionals across the Hillel movement. The Director of Instruction will serve as a key representative of Hillel International’s Campus Climate Initiative (CCI) by delivering an array of educational opportunities for university leaders and other stakeholders. In this role, you will contribute to a growing department of educators and consultants working to improve campus climate for Jewish students and all students. The successful candidate in this position will report to the Director of Education and collaborate with members of CCI’s Education and Consulting divisions. This is a primarily remote position with up to 50% travel (regionally and nationally). What You’ll Do Facilitate in-person and virtual workshops and other educational programming for various audiences, including but not limited to university administrators, faculty, and staff, Jewish community professionals, and students Serve as a practitioner-educator for university administrators, teaching implementable best practices and strategies to support Jewish students, respond to antisemitism, and strengthen campus climate. Serve as one of the lead facilitators for the CCI program, including teaching for CCI Education and CCI Consulting. Travel as needed to partner campuses regionally and nationally within the United States (This position is approximately 50% travel.) What You’ve Accomplished Advanced degree or graduate coursework required (e.g., MA; ABD; BA + in-progress doctorate) Extensive coursework in Jewish Studies, antisemitism studies, or a related field 5+ years of teaching experience at the postsecondary level Proven success shaping curriculum and instruction to the needs of specific student populations Established familiarity with research and pedagogy in one or more of the following areas: historical and contemporary antisemitism, Jewish history, student affairs administration, student belonging and identity development, or Middle East history and policy Experience working with Jewish communities and/or students What You’ll Bring to the Job Sensitivity to a wide range of knowledge levels with regard to Judaism, Jewish life, and antisemitism Dedication to Jewish student inclusion and success Capabilities to work independently and collaboratively within and across teams, successfully managing multiple priorities Strong oral and written communication skills What You’ll Receive Competitive salary in the nonprofit marketplace. The salary range for this role is $95,000-$105,000. Travel regionally and occasionally nationally (50%) A comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, retirement plan, Life, AD&D, and Long Term Disability (LTD) insurance, Flexible Spending accounts, generous vacation/sick time, and parental leave. Great professional development, mentoring, and skill-building opportunities About Hillel International In 1923, Rabbi Benjamin Frankel started Hillel with humble means, a noble mission and a breathtaking vision: to convey Jewish civilization to a new generation. Today, Hillel International continues to enrich the lives of Jewish students and is the largest Jewish campus organization in the world at nearly 1,000 colleges and universities across North America and around the world. As Hillel evolves as an organization, the mission remains steadfast: to create lasting connections with every Jewish student that foster an enduring commitment to Jewish life, learning, and Israel and train them to become the next Jewish leaders. Hillel is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an accepting and inclusive environment for all.

Buscamos personas comprometidas, responsables y con vocación de servicio para asegurar que nuestras operaciones lleguen a cada destino de manera eficiente y segura.

We are building it with a deliberately lean team of senior owners, supported by specialist partners for platform, support, risk and payments, and AI tooling in every function. Every hire owns a whole remit, not a slice of one, and their decisions show up directly in the numbers of a brand at launch. pre-launch QA checklist in place, with every campaign going through it A standard post-campaign report the team reads and acts on First 12 months A reliable campaign engine: high volume, on schedule and without errors Measurable lift in repeat purchase, retention and reactivation from CRM and promotions Every major campaign with a known ROI, and a growing playbook of proven mechanics A promotions calendar players look forward to, which sets the brand apart How We'll Measure It Campaign uptake and conversion Repeat-purchase and reactivation rate Revenue and ROI per campaign Email, SMS and push engagement On-time delivery Error-free launches What you'll bring 3+ years running CRM, campaigns or promotions in online casino, social casino, sweepstakes or gaming Hands-on experience with a CRM or review_candidates.title: CDI - Global Marketing Director (F/M/X)
review_candidates.description: Job description: PERMANENT CONTRACT - Global Marketing Director (M/F/X) At Sephora, beauty is about feeling seen, valued, and empowered, individually and collectively. It is connecting deeply with others, celebrating diversity and inclusivity, unlocking your potential and making a difference every day. Together, we belong to something beautiful. Since its inception in 1969 in Limoges, France, and as part of the LVMH Group since 1997, Sephora has been disrupting the prestige beauty retail industry. Today, Sephora continues to break with convention to drive its mission: champion a world of inspiration and inclusion where everyone can celebrate their beauty. With 56,000 employees in 35 countries, we connect customers and beauty brands within the world’s most passionate beauty community. With a curation of nearly 500 brands, and our own label, Sephora Collection, we offer the most unique and diverse range of products: fragrances, makeup, hair care, skincare... and much more. Sephora has built one of the leading retail brands in the world but has historically operated with a very localized structure. As one of the few retailers to arrive on the Interbrand list of the world’s most valuable brands, Sephora has an opportunity to scale its leadership even further. The Global Director of Integrated Marketing will play a critical role in enabling Sephora’s success worldwide, partnering with our regional teams to foster best practices and develop impactful, globally leveraged marketing programs. This position is central to shaping and executing our global marketing initiatives, ensuring that Sephora's brand presence is consistently inspiring and impactful. The role will report to the Global VP, Integrated Marketing. You will excel and enjoy this position if you are ready to actively handle the following missions : Global Campaign Development Work with agency partners to develop unique 360 campaign programs that can be leveraged and scaled across global markets.Ensure outsourced deliverables continues to foster the creative vision for the Sephora brand expression and DNA. Collaborate with regional marketing teams to scale ‘leveraged’ creative, ensuring deliverables meet the needs of our global marketing community at large. Project management for global marketing initiatives, covering managing external agencies, coordinating projects with regional marketing leads, budget planning, time management and coordination with legal and procurement. Lead the strategic approach to messaging for Globally led integrated campaigns, ensuring consistency and relevance across diverse international markets. Regional Support and Collaboration Provide strategic guidance, coaching and support to regions across creation and execution of Integrated Marketing campaigns, programs, and activations. Collaborate with regions to facilitate the global sharing of marketing calendars and best practices, fostering alignment, knowledge-sharing and synergy where needed. Foster a culture of knowledge-sharing by identifying and championing successful regional initiatives and creating mechanisms for their global dissemination and adoption. Serve as a key support for regions, offering support, insights, and strategic input to ensure local marketing efforts are impactful and consistent with global objectives. Actively listen and action regional needs and challenges, advocating for solutions and resources that empower markets to deliver outstanding integrated marketing results Signature Marketing Experiences and Live Events Lead the conceptualization and development of global brand events such as SEPHORiA, ensuring they are memorable, on-brand, and relevant across regions. Develop best practice playbooks for pop-ups and live brand activations, facilitating seamless execution globally. Identifies innovative ways where Sephora can authentically embody its "Welcome all the world of beauty" values through compelling brand experiences. Ensure out-of-store experiences adhere to retail best practices and reinforce a cohesive brand presence. Your key collaborators will be: Regional CMOs and their teams – SVPs/VPs Agency partners and other 3rd party collaborators. Regional brand partnership teams (collaborates on sports, music, entertainment activations) Global store design teams (ensures our out-of-store experiences adhere to retail best practices) Global PR & comms (helps reinforce our global brand position and corporate reputation with key stakeholders) Do not hesitate to apply if you have… or if you are … 12+ years of integrated marketing expertise in international and multicultural organizations Preference for hands-on experience in marcom and creative development (advertising, experiential and live events, content creation, 360 campaigns) The ideal candidate will have worked both agency-side and in-house Proven ability to manage complex processes and teams, and 3rd party collaborations, in fast-paced environments. The position is located in Neuilly sur Seine (Paris area). Here, you will find: Community, in which authenticity is embraced, and the strength of our differences fuels our collective spirit. Culture of empowerment, learning & growth, that offers you the tools, space and opportunity to learn, innovate and lead. Work that brings fulfillment. From delighting clients every day, to inspiring our industry at large, every action makes a difference. Join us and belong to something beautiful. At Sephora, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating and fostering an inclusive environment for everyone. __________ CDI – Global Marketing Director (F/H/X) Chez Sephora, la beauté, c’est se sentir reconnu, valorisé et épanoui, aussi bien individuellement que collectivement. C’est tisser des liens profonds avec les autres, célébrer la diversité et l’inclusion, révéler son propre potentiel et agir chaque jour pour avoir un impact positif. Depuis notre création en 1969 à Limoges, en France, et notre intégration au sein du groupe LVMH en 1997, nous n’avons cessé de réinventer la beauté de prestige. Aujourd’hui encore, nous continuons de casser les codes, portés par notre raison d’être : promouvoir un monde d’inspiration et d’inclusion où chaque personne est invitée à célébrer librement sa beauté. Avec 56 000 collaborateurs dans 35 pays, nous réunissons clients, marques et passionnés au sein de la communauté beauté la plus vaste et la plus vibrante au monde. Grâce à une sélection de près de 500 marques, et à notre propre marque, Sephora Collection, nous proposons la gamme la plus unique et diversifiée de produits : parfums, maquillage, soins capillaires, soins de la peau… et bien plus encore. Sephora a construit l’une des marques retail les plus fortes au monde, tout en ayant historiquement fonctionné selon une structure très localisée. En tant que l’un des rares retailers à figurer au classement Interbrand des marques les plus valorisées au monde, Sephora a l’opportunité d’amplifier encore davantage son leadership. Le/la Directeur(trice) Global(e) du Marketing Intégré jouera un rôle essentiel dans la réussite de Sephora à l’échelle mondiale, en collaborant avec nos équipes régionales afin de favoriser le partage des bonnes pratiques et de développer des programmes marketing impactants, pouvant être déployés à l’international. Ce poste est clé dans la définition et l’exécution de nos initiatives marketing globales, afin de garantir une présence de marque Sephora toujours inspirante et à fort impact. Le poste reportera au/à la VP Global(e), Marketing Intégré. Vous excellerez et vous épanouirez dans ce rôle si vous souhaitez… Développement de campagnes globales Travailler avec les partenaires agences afin de développer des programmes de campagnes 360 uniques, pouvant être déployés et adaptés à grande échelle sur les marchés internationaux. Veiller à ce que les livrables externalisés continuent de nourrir la vision créative de l’expression de marque et de l’ADN Sephora. Collaborer avec les équipes marketing régionales afin de déployer des créations « mutualisées », en veillant à ce que les livrables répondent aux besoins de l’ensemble de notre communauté marketing mondiale. Assurer la gestion de projets pour les initiatives marketing globales, incluant le pilotage des agences externes, la coordination des projets avec les responsables marketing régionaux, la planification budgétaire, la gestion des délais et la coordination avec les équipes juridiques et achats. Piloter l’approche stratégique des messages pour les campagnes intégrées menées au niveau global, en garantissant cohérence et pertinence sur des marchés internationaux variés. Soutien et collaboration avec les régions Apporter une orientation stratégique, du coaching et un soutien aux régions dans la création et l’exécution de campagnes, programmes et activations de marketing intégré. Collaborer avec les régions afin de faciliter le partage global des calendriers marketing et des bonnes pratiques, en favorisant l’alignement, le partage des connaissances et les synergies lorsque nécessaire. Favoriser une culture de partage des connaissances en identifiant et en valorisant les initiatives régionales réussies, et en créant des mécanismes permettant leur diffusion et leur adoption à l’échelle mondiale. Agir comme un soutien clé pour les régions, en apportant accompagnement, insights et contribution stratégique afin de garantir que les actions marketing locales soient impactantes et cohérentes avec les objectifs globaux. Écouter activement les besoins et défis des régions et agir en conséquence, en portant les solutions et ressources nécessaires pour permettre aux marchés de délivrer des résultats remarquables en marketing intégré. Expériences marketing signature et événements live Piloter la conception et le développement d’événements de marque globaux tels que SEPHORiA, en veillant à ce qu’ils soient mémorables, fidèles à la marque et pertinents dans toutes les régions. Développer des playbooks de bonnes pratiques pour les pop-ups et les activations de marque live, afin de faciliter une exécution fluide à l’échelle mondiale. Identifier des façons innovantes pour Sephora d’incarner authentiquement ses valeurs « Welcome all the world of beauty » à travers des expériences de marque fortes. Veiller à ce que les expériences hors magasin respectent les meilleures pratiques retail et renforcent une présence de marque cohérente. Vos principaux interlocuteurs seront : Les CMO régionaux et leurs équipes – SVP/VP Les partenaires agences et autres collaborateurs tiers. Les équipes régionales de partenariats de marque (collaboration sur les activations sport, musique et divertissement) Les équipes globales de design magasin (garantes du respect des meilleures pratiques retail pour nos expériences hors magasin) Les équipes globales PR & communication (qui contribuent à renforcer notre positionnement de marque global et notre réputation corporate auprès des parties prenantes clés) N’hésitez plus à postuler si vous avez… ou si vous êtes… 12 ans ou plus d’expertise en marketing intégré au sein d’organisations internationales et multiculturelles Une expérience opérationnelle en communication marketing et en développement créatif serait appréciée (publicité, expériences et événements live, création de contenu, campagnes 360°) Le profil idéal aura évolué à la fois en agence et chez l’annonceur Une capacité démontrée à piloter des processus et des équipes complexes, ainsi que des collaborations avec des partenaires externes, dans des environnements en évolution rapide. Le poste est basé à Neuilly-sur-Seine, en région parisienne. À nos côtés , vous découvrirez : Une communauté où l'authenticité est une force, et où notre esprit d’équipe se nourrit de nos différences. Vous serez entouré d’équipes talentueuses avec lesquelles vous serez fier de collaborer. Une culture qui favorise le développement personnel et le leadership, avec des ressources et des opportunités pour apprendre, innover et évoluer. Un métier qui a du sens où chaque action compte : qu'il s'agisse de créer des expériences uniques pour nos clients ou d'inspirer l'univers de la beauté, nous évoluons dans un environnement où chacun contribue à faire la différence. Ensemble, partageons quelque chose de beau. Chez Sephora, nous célébrons la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer et à favoriser un environnement inclusif pour tous.
